baseline.edition: 1647 English text in Philip Schaff, The Creeds of Christendom, Volume III (fourth edition, 1919); original wording, modernized spelling and punctuation; without American alterations or proof texts

comparison.edition: Official PCA-published confession, 2022 PDF, accessed 14 November 2026; PCA preface identifies this publication as the standards adopted by the PCA

method: Compared every confession section in the local baseline with the corresponding PCA confession paragraph, excluding the Scripture-proof apparatus.
Extracted body text separately from smaller proof text and superscript markers; checked the complete section sequence and examined every lexical difference.
Treated capitalization, punctuation, compound spacing, spelling and book-list arrangement separately from substantive adopted-text differences.
Recorded smaller wording differences and apparent errors separately; no doctrinal intention is inferred from a typographical variant.
Used the official PCA PDF and preface directly. OPC’s revision table is corroborating evidence, not a substitute for PCA verification.
limits: This compares the named official PCA publication available at review time; it is not a survey of individual subscriptions or a claim about all Presbyterian editions.
The hosted transcript is unchanged. Its apparent errors have not been silently repaired or certified as readings of the printed Schaff edition; a separate facsimile collation is needed.
No complete modern edition, proof apparatus or publisher commentary is reproduced here. The audit summaries are original editorial comparisons.
